shell.war_room.note: Subtitle beside the brand URIM in the top bar: the name of this review app. Written in capitals.

shell.demo_corpus.note: Badge in the top bar when the app shows the demo corpus instead of the working one

shell.totals.drafts.note: Top-bar counter label: how many items are drafts awaiting review

shell.totals.sent_back.note: Top-bar counter label: how many items were sent back with a change request

shell.totals.approved.note: Top-bar counter label: how many items are approved

shell.streak.note: Top-bar counter label: consecutive days with at least one review (game term)

shell.streak_title: Days in a row with at least one review

shell.next_level.note: Under the experience bar: the XP total at which the next level starts

shell.codex_link.note: Top-bar link to the Illuminated Codex, the reading app

shell.codex_title: Read without review: the Illuminated Codex

shell.language_title.note: Tooltip of the language picker: which language bundle the corpus is shown in

shell.nav.command.note: Navigation: the overview screen (a war-room command post)

shell.nav.campaign.note: Navigation: the autonomous run that writes a book unattended

shell.nav.review.note: Navigation: the review deck where items are approved or sent back

shell.nav.xray.note: Navigation: the verse-by-verse view of every layer

shell.nav.causal.note: Navigation: the graph of causes and effects between events

shell.nav.dossiers.note: Navigation: files on people, places and things

shell.loading.note: Shown while data loads; an ellipsis follows

shell.unreviewed.note: Status pill of an item that has no review status yet

shell.not_in_ledger.note: Pill shown when an item has no entry in the review ledger

shell.review.reopen.note: Button: turn an approved item back into a draft

shell.review.send_back.note: Button: request changes to this item

shell.review.send.note: Button: send the change request written in the field

shell.margin_relative.note: An event's timing margin relative to its anchor; 'rel.' abbreviates 'relative'. {margin} is a duration like '2 d'

shell.timing.note: Label before the note that explains how an event was dated

shell.causal.overlaps.note: Between a cause and its effect: the two events overlap in time

shell.causal.immediately.note: Between a cause and its effect: no time passes

shell.causal.after.note: Between a cause and its effect: the time that passes, e.g. 'after 3 d'

shell.similarity.note: Tooltip on a search hit found by meaning; {value} is a number between 0 and 1

shell.toast.xp.note: Notification after a review decision: experience points gained

shell.toast.badge.note: Notification when a badge is earned; {name} is the badge's name

shell.rank_up.note: Full-screen announcement when the player reaches a new rank; written in capitals

shell.rank.scout.note: Player rank 1 of 10, from lowest to highest

shell.rank.runner.note: Player rank 2 of 10, from lowest to highest

shell.rank.scribe.note: Player rank 3 of 10, from lowest to highest

shell.rank.watchman.note: Player rank 4 of 10, from lowest to highest

shell.rank.herald.note: Player rank 5 of 10, from lowest to highest

shell.rank.captain.note: Player rank 6 of 10, from lowest to highest

shell.rank.seer.note: Player rank 7 of 10, from lowest to highest

shell.rank.prophet.note: Player rank 8 of 10, from lowest to highest

shell.rank.judge.note: Player rank 9 of 10, from lowest to highest

shell.rank.sanhedrin.note: Player rank 10 of 10, from lowest to highest

shell.badge.first_seal.description.note: How to earn the badge 'First Seal'

shell.badge.sharp_eye.description.text: Send 5 items back with a note
shell.badge.sharp_eye.description.note: How to earn the badge 'Sharp Eye'

shell.badge.conqueror.description.text: Clear a chapter: 10+ items, all approved
shell.badge.conqueror.description.note: How to earn the badge 'Territory Held'

shell.badge.vigil.description.text: Review on 7 days in a row
shell.badge.vigil.description.note: How to earn the badge 'Seven Watches'
